directEvidence: EDRI says direct ad-hoc price varies by location, charger type and payment method and is shown at the charger/QR; roaming pricing is separate; some sites may add displayed idle fees.
investigated.safeDecision: Do not infer an Italy-wide tariff; resolve each IT*UFC EVSE from charger/QR/weblink/backend payload.

investigated.name: WROOM SRL SB a socio unico
directEvidence: Wroom terms define the app as an eMSP with owned and interoperable third-party stations; tariffs are specified for each station and can contain energy, charging-time, parking/idle and activation components; prices may vary by charger brand/model, geography, power and owning CPO and are displayed before activation.
investigated.safeDecision: Do not infer a WRM-wide tariff and do not mix Wroom eMSP roaming prices with direct Wroom-owned CPO prices.
investigated.resumeCondition: extract Wroom app/backend per-EVSE tariff and ownership/channel, preserving fixed/time/idle components

notes: No roaming/eMSP price was promoted as a direct CPO tariff.
